Bayesian model

Bayesian model specifications

# Bayesian models specifications ---------------------------------------------------------
# Define options for the NUTS sampler
nchains <- 4    # number of chains (at least 4 for NUTS sampling)
niter <- 10000   # number of iterations per chain
nwarm <- 5000   # number of iterations to warm up before sampling 
#4 x (10000-5000)= 20000 iterations

Models wet 10-20

pH Log model wet 10-20

#pHlog model
fitGLMM1_D <- brm(pHlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM1_D)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: pHlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 65) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     0.89      0.29     0.48     1.62 1.00     6159    10036
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                                 1.04      0.59    -0.15     2.22 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP                         -1.18      0.37    -1.91    -0.45 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                           -1.17      0.83    -2.82     0.50 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous                     -1.09      0.84    -2.74     0.62 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                       -1.40      0.84    -3.08     0.26 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid           2.01      0.49     1.04     2.97 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous     1.09      0.48     0.14     2.03 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain       0.88      0.49    -0.09     1.83 1.00
##                                       Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                                10173     9957
## PD.disturbanceWP                         12785    11168
## Grass.typeArid                           10513     9794
## Grass.typeCalcareous                     10432    10637
## Grass.typeMountain                        9957    10399
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid          13824    13231
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous    13970    13020
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      14390    14046
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.65      0.07     0.53     0.80 1.00    13232    12165
## 
## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
fitGLMM1_D$prior
##                 prior     class                                  coef group
##                (flat)         b                                            
##                (flat)         b                        Grass.typeArid      
##                (flat)         b                  Grass.typeCalcareous      
##                (flat)         b                    Grass.typeMountain      
##                (flat)         b                      PD.disturbanceWP      
##                (flat)         b       PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid      
##                (flat)         b PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous      
##                (flat)         b   PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      
##  student_t(3, 0, 2.5) Intercept                                            
##  student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                            
##  student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                          ID
##  student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                             Intercept    ID
##  student_t(3, 0, 2.5)     sigma                                            
##  resp dpar nlpar lb ub       source
##                             default
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                             default
##                   0         default
##                   0    (vectorized)
##                   0    (vectorized)
##                   0         default
pHlog1_D1<-fitGLMM1_D %>%
  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "pH scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
pHlog1_D1

#obtaining HPD (HIGHEST POSTERIOR DENSITY)
emmeansph1<-emmeans(fitGLMM1_D,pairwise~Grass.type, adjust="tukey")
## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
emmeansph2<-emmeans(fitGLMM1_D,pairwise~PD.disturbance, adjust="tukey") 
## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
emmeansph3<-emmeans(fitGLMM1_D,pairwise~PD.disturbance:Grass.type, adjust="tukey") 
emmeansph1

                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)

  theme(legend.position="none")+

#K log model 

fitGLMM4_D <- brm(Klog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM4_D)

#Mg log model 

fitGLMM5_D <- brm(Mglog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM5_D)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity

##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
##

## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS

Mglog1_D2<-fitGLMM5_D %>%
  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "Mg scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
  Mglog1_D2

#P log model #has two divergences
fitGLMM7_D <- brm(P.TUDlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM7_D)

#Corg log model 
fitGLMM8_D <- brm(Corglog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM8_D)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity

##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
##

## ~ID (Number of levels: 12)

Corglog1_D2<-fitGLMM8_D %>%
  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "C. Org scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
Corglog1_D2

#TN log model 
fitGLMM9_D <- brm(TNlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM9_D)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: TNlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 65) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     0.65      0.23     0.33     1.22 1.00     4998     8905
##

##                                       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat

## PD.disturbanceWP                         -0.18      0.30    -0.78     0.42 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                           -0.70      0.62    -1.93     0.52 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous                      0.26      0.61    -0.95     1.48 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                        1.04      0.62    -0.19     2.29 1.00

## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain       0.44      0.40    -0.35     1.23 1.00
##                                       Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                                 9981     9447
## PD.disturbanceWP                         10993    12079
## Grass.typeArid                           10122    10277
## Grass.typeCalcareous                     10670    10938
## Grass.typeMountain                        9821     9845
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid          12985    13372
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous    12883    13051
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      12969    13656
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.54      0.06     0.45     0.67 1.00    12281    12514
## 
## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
fitGLMM9_D$prior
##                    prior     class                                  coef group
##                   (flat)         b                                            
##                   (flat)         b                        Grass.typeArid      
##                   (flat)         b                  Grass.typeCalcareous      
##                   (flat)         b                    Grass.typeMountain      
##                   (flat)         b                      PD.disturbanceWP      
##                   (flat)         b       PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid      
##                   (flat)         b PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous      
##                   (flat)         b   PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      
##  student_t(3, -0.2, 2.5) Intercept                                            
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                            
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                          ID
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                             Intercept    ID
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)     sigma                                            
##  resp dpar nlpar lb ub       source
##                             default
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                             default
##                   0         default
##                   0    (vectorized)
##                   0    (vectorized)
##                   0         default
TNlog1_D2<-fitGLMM8_D %>%
  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "TN scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
TNlog1_D2

## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
emmeansnit3<-emmeans(fitGLMM9_D,pairwise~PD.disturbance:Grass.type, adjust="tukey") 
emmeansnit1

#obtaining ROPE (REGION OF PRACTICAL EQUIVALENCE)
fitglmm9.rg<-(ref_grid(fitGLMM9_D)) # having an emmgrid from the model 
ropenit1<-rope(emmeans(fitglmm9.rg, pairwise~Grass.type), ci = c(.90, .95)) #####ROPE!!
## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
ropenit2<-rope(emmeans(fitglmm9.rg, pairwise~PD.disturbance), ci = c(.90, .95)) #####ROPE!! 
## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
ropenit3<-rope(emmeans(fitglmm9.rg, pairwise~PD.disturbance:Grass.type), ci = c(.90, .95)) #####ROPE!!
ropenit1
